purpose: Top-level directories this repo serves that are NOT pages of billionairehighperformancecoach.com or spryexecutiveos.com, so no generator may list them in the shared sites' guide indexes, navigation hubs, citation registries, visible-FAQ pass, sitemaps or llms files, and no shared-site page validator may count them. The exclusion lives here, not in a robots meta: aplayermode/ is indexable on its own domain (owner, 10 Oct 2026) and must still stay out of the shared sites' indexes; amazon/ is noindex by its own contract AND listed here.
guard: scripts/validators/validate_aplayermode_landing.mjs (section 'kept out of the shared sites' indexes') refuses a list without aplayermode/ and amazon/, a reader that no longer reads this file, and any guide index, registry, sitemap or llms file that names an excluded page.

dirs.aplayermode: A Player Mode landing page; canonical https://aplayermode.com/, served there by workers/aplayermode-com with its own robots.txt, sitemap.xml and llms.txt.
dirs.amazon: Per-book Amazon landing pages; noindex by design (scripts/validators/validate_amazon_book_landing.mjs).
